title: Geometry-Analysis-Certificate triangle
statement: Read every phenomenon through geometry, analysis, and certificate.

title: Observable anatomy
statement: Every arithmetic function is checked through structure/geometry/average/normal order/limiting law/tail/moments/maximal order/wall/certificate before any claim.

title: Test phase before randomness
statement: Test the pretentious/Halasz phase before claiming cancellation or randomness of a multiplicative function.

title: Average is not normal order
statement: Average order, normal order, concentration, and cancellation are distinct tests; do not infer one from another.

title: Claim/Formalization separation
statement: A claim is not its formalization; encode language, assumptions, and inference rules explicitly before reasoning. Governance/certificate discipline, not a theorem or proof machinery.

title: Syntax/Semantics separation
statement: A formula (syntax) is not its truth (semantics); relate the two only via named metatheorems. Governance/certificate discipline, not a theorem or proof machinery.

title: Metatheory awareness
statement: A formal theory is the object; the metatheory is the external layer reasoning about it. Never confuse a claim inside a system with a verified claim about the system. Governance/certificate discipline, not a theorem or proof machinery.

title: Proof/Deduction/Certificate separation
statement: Informal proof, formal deduction, machine verification, and research certificate are distinct levels; never conflate them. Check the derivation, do not trust the conclusion's plausibility. Governance/certificate discipline, not a theorem or proof machinery.

title: No-false-certificate (soundness)
statement: By soundness, if a statement is derivable in the formal system then it is true under the certified semantics; a valid derivation never certifies a falsehood. Governance/certificate discipline, not a theorem or proof machinery.

title: Zero density is not negligible impact
statement: A zero-density set may still affect or dominate averages of unbounded observables; a thin exceptional set is not automatically negligible when the observable is unbounded. Governance/diagnostic operating rule, not a theorem.

title: Task first
statement: No book mining, knowledge acquisition, formalization, experiment, or tool activation begins without a named research task and deliverable.

title: Readiness before execution
statement: Every load-bearing prerequisite must be operationally ready before a research task begins; otherwise targeted acquisition precedes execution.

title: Minimum sufficient knowledge
statement: Acquire only the smallest trusted knowledge package sufficient to attempt the active lemma rigorously; stop mining when the readiness gate passes.

title: Knowledge returns to the mind
statement: Every prerequisite acquired for a task must be integrated back with statement, hypotheses, source, limitation, PVG bridge, and operational status.

title: One active original research front
statement: Only one original research front may be active at a time; maintenance work may coexist but may not create a second research question.

title: Do not rebuild certified bridges
statement: A certified PVG-ANT bridge is reused from the language kernel and is not rederived from scratch unless a defect or stronger version is named.

title: Escalate the stage ceiling
statement: After a maturity level closes, the next stage must require a stronger output: translation to structure, structure to transfer, transfer to mechanism, mechanism to original lemma, lemma to theorem.

title: PVG necessity test
statement: Before calling a result a PVG contribution, test whether removing PVG leaves essentially the same idea and proof; if so, cap the claim at reinterpretation or proof economy unless another material gain is certified.

title: Canonical remote-local synchronization
statement: Every work session begins from a fetched and verified origin/main; local main advances only by fast-forward, while dirty, ahead, diverged, or unexpected-remote states stop automatic synchronization.

title: Every closed stage returns a tested capability delta
statement: No stage is closed as maturation without a machine-readable receipt for knowledge, language, reasoning, certificates, failure memory, verification, synchronization, and the preserved scientific ceiling.

title: Knowledge becomes operational through the common language
statement: Knowledge enters the Central Mind only through a source-grounded PVG-ANT record with exact hypotheses, native objects, admissible morphisms, preservation and loss, tool routing, reverse conditions, tests, and honest classification.

title: Sync-per-stage receipts
statement: Local-remote synchronization is an operational condition of every program stage: a Pre-stage sync receipt (HEAD == origin/main, clean tracked tree) is required before work starts, and a Post-stage sync receipt (branch=main, ahead=0, behind=0, tracked changes=0) is required before any stage closes; the scheduled sync task is a helper layer, never a substitute.
